news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (5.4% operating cash flow to total debt). news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹3.60 loss per share (vs ₹3.98 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹3.60 loss per share (improved from ₹3.98 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹188.9m (down 24% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹47.5m (loss narrowed 8.5% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 56% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 32% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹2.24 loss per share (vs ₹1.53 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹2.24 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹1.53 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹261.8m (down 20% from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹29.5m (loss widened 41% from 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 30 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.
